## Who is GujjarX?
GujjarX = Gandhi Gujjar. Both names refer to the same public online identity. GujjarX is a technology-focused public online identity. GujjarX works across AI automation, WhatsApp Business Platform/API systems, websites, SEO, server and VPS automation, API integrations and digital product development.
